fieldNotes.siteResolution: Supplied coords (29.8283,-82.5967) landed in downtown High Springs (houses/small commercial, no plant). Google ROOFTOP geocode of '7100 NE County Rd 340, High Springs FL 32643' returned 29.81821,-82.68969, which satellite confirmed as the large industrial bottling/distribution plant SW of town near the Santa Fe River / Ginnie Springs. This is the BlueTriton Brands (Primo Brands) High Springs water plant, formerly Nestle Waters (TruckMap/YP list it as 'Nestle Waters High Springs, 7100 NE County Road 340'). Locked building centroid 29.81830,-82.68970.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE, high confidence. Street View up the entry drive (pano mMYa1zJeJf_erlM6PvF9_g, 2026-04, heading ~344-350) clearly shows a white cantilever/sliding gate across the full width of the truck/entry drive at the property line, with chain-link perimeter fencing running both directions and directory/check-in sign posts flanking the drive (blue sign left, post right). Satellite (z20) shows the gated drive widening to ~2 lanes inbound.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE, high confidence. No booth-sized structure (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-side windows) at or beside the gate in Street View or satellite. The gate stands alone with signage only.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE (truck gate present, no guard shack -> implies kiosk/call-box/app check-in). Marked uncertain only because the exact check-in mechanism (the flanking sign posts may be a callbox/keypad) cannot be read from imagery; the gate-without-booth pattern is clear.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Entry drive widens to ~2 lanes at the gate (z20 shows two painted lane arrows on the approach). Inbound = 2.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single shared return lane back to CR 340; exit shares the same gated drive (entry/exit together). Estimated 1, low confidence.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: TRUE - one gated drive from CR 340 serves both in and out; no separate out-gate elsewhere on the perimeter.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and a large internal paved truck loop/turnaround on the NE/E side give ample room to add a bypass/express lane; ~2 inbound lanes already. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck loop ('racetrack' oval) on the NE/E side of the building plus broad internal aprons act as an inside-the-gate queue/staging area before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach: gated drive from CR 340 to the building plus the internal loop easily holds 3+ queued trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Banded 50+. Long, regular dock-door rhythm with trailers backed in on the NORTH face (~20+ doors, z19 northyard), the SOUTH face (~20+ doors, z19 SW), and additional doors on the building's E/NE inset face. Honest total estimate ~55-65 across faces -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~60, approximate; counted from trailer-backing rhythm across N/S/E faces in z19 crops. Could be +/-15.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Banded 50+. Dense rows of parked trailers (no tractors) along the north field edge, the south edge, and the SW corner; ~50-70 trailer slots visible across the drop rows.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - dedicated trailer-storage rows along the N and S perimeter, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~70 across all rows/docks (N row, S row, SW corner, scattered on the loop); mixed but consistent imagery vintage. Approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~90 including the paved loop shoulders and unused apron width. Approximate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on the north face and the south face on different building sides suggest split ship/receive, but function cannot be confirmed from imagery - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: ONE large L-shaped distribution/bottling building with an attached process/utility annex on the E side (counted as one complex). No second detached large building -> multipleFacilities FALSE.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: RURAL - isolated industrial site surrounded by open fields, forest, and a sand/mining pit to the south; nearest town fabric (downtown High Springs) is ~9 km NE. CR 340 is a rural 2-lane road.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Inferred TRUE - remote rural site in forested/agricultural land west of High Springs near the Santa Fe River; cellular coverage likely weaker than metro. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad with scale house identified in the truck path. FALSE.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; access is the CR 340 drive only. FALSE.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~30 acres of cleared/paved/graded footprint inside the fence (building + aprons + loop + drop rows + parking), derived from the perimeter polygon. Surrounding land is fields/forest, not yard.
fieldNotes.imageryQuality: Maxar/Airbus 2026 imagery, sharp; Street View 2026-04 at the entrance. High confidence on gate, building, docks, layout.
